artifacts.summary: Three-phase closeout plan: verify the reconciliation ledger against the live tree, forward report section 2.4's three categorical questions to task 618 (the one un-forwarded recommendation), and write the closeout summary. No FormalSystem/ or Tests/ change by design.

partial_progress.details: Plan file written and field-verified (Status, Task, Effort, Type, per-phase Depends on and Verification Tier, wave table consistent with per-phase dependencies)

memory_candidates.content: When a verdict-first research task is re-dispatched for planning after its recommendations have already been executed by downstream tasks, the correct plan is a closeout plan, not a build plan: (1) a read-only verification sweep confirming each recommendation against the live tree rather than against the task description's own reconciliation note, carrying an explicit Scope Hypothesis so a falsified claim halts the closeout instead of being papered over; (2) a phase for each recommendation with no recipient (the common residue is a forwarding note to a related not_started task); (3) an execution summary with a recommendation-verdict-evidence ledger and an open-questions ownership table mapping every UNVERIFIED item to its owning task or to an explicit no-owner non-goal. The failure mode this avoids is scheduling implementation work that a completed sibling task already delivered.
